Title: Diagnosis of test `testGenerateURLFragment`
Details: The test `testGenerateURLFragment` checks whether HTML entities such as `"` are correctly escaped to their corresponding character by the `StandardToolTipTagFragmentGenerator.generateToolTipFragment` method. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Consequently, un-escaped strings are being returned, which leads to the error demonstrated by the test.

Title: Diagnosis of test `org.apache.commons.csv.CSVPrinterTest.testHeader()`
Details: The test `org.apache.commons.csv.CSVPrinterTest.testHeader()` is testing the `testHeader` method in the `CSVPrinterTest` class from the Apache Commons CSV library. The test sets up a `CSVPrinter` with a specific header containing columns "C1", "C2", and "C3", prints records, and then asserts the output against an expected CSV string.

The failure of this test indicates that the actual CSV string generated by the `CSVPrinter` does not match the expected CSV string. This suggests a potential issue with either the header configuration or the record printing logic in the `CSVPrinter`.

Next, I will proceed to investigate the code snippet of the `CSVPrinter` class to determine the exact cause of the discrepancy in the generated CSV output.
